vulnerabilityTitle: Unbounded Slab Allocation & Negative Size Bypass
summary: Enforced 16 MiB per-slab cap, positive integer validation, and 256 MiB total heap quota.
rootCause: Allocator trusted caller-supplied byte counts without finite/integer checks or heap accounting.

diffLines.content: // Contract: function execute(input, env) -> { ok: boolean, allowed: boolean, allocatedBytes: number, slabId?: string, reason: string }
const MAX_SLAB_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024; // 16 MiB strict per-allocation cap

environmentImpact: Eliminated heap spike variance across worker slabs with negligible 0.002ms bounds-check overhead.
